nanochat.local_patch: see PIN.md 'Local changes'; git diff of the vendoring commit shows all of them

python_env.install: uv sync --extra gpu (uses the vendored uv.lock)

fa3.revision_source: HF API 'sha' of the repo main branch, read 2026-10-07 (lastModified 2026-03-20); UNCERTAIN until env_smoke_test.py confirms it loads

data.dataset_revision_note: nanochat downloads from resolve/main; the revision above is what main pointed to on 2026-10-07 (HF API, UNCERTAIN). Per-shard sha256 in results/<run>/manifest.json is the actual proof.
data.reference_sha256_source: computed on our workstation from shards downloaded 2026-07-03
data.tokenizer: trained in-run by scripts.tok_train (vocab 32768, max_chars 2e9); sha256 recorded in manifest.json
data.eval_bundle_sha256: recorded in manifest.json (not known in advance)

recipe.seed_note: hardcoded torch.manual_seed(42) in nanochat/common.py compute_init; run name suffix s0 = first seed

hardware.gpu: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB (SXM preferred; Hopper sm_90 required for the FA3 kernel)
hardware.not_blackwell: FA3 has no sm_100/sm_120 kernel; nanochat falls back to SDPA without sliding windows (discussion #819, RTX 5090)
hardware.driver: >= R570 (CUDA 12.8 runtime); UNCERTAIN, general CUDA requirement, not stated by nanochat
